scoring_justification: T0 result-level comparison: the checker reads the agent's reported band_gap_eV and compares it to the paper's gold (0.19 eV) with an absolute tolerance of 0.1 eV. A full recompute from raw band energies is infeasible because the output contract does not require the agent to submit the band structure data.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference band gap 0.19 eV for Ba8Si6Sn
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper abstract and Fig. 6 caption ("semi conductor with a small band gap of 0.19 eV" and DOS inset showing 0.194 eV)
hidden_assets.generation_method: value taken from the abstract, rounded to 0.19 eV
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: this is the paper's own reported DFT band gap

outputs.description: Band gap value, direct/indirect character, and optionally VBM/CBM k-point coordinates for Ba8Si6Sn obtained from DFT.

output_contract.notes: The band gap is expected to be small but positive. The reported value will be compared to the paper's reported band gap within a tolerance, and semiconducting behavior (gap > 0.01 eV) checked.
